scene.en: Your friend Ola has tickets for a concert this weekend. On Friday evening you have dinner at your grandma's, but on Saturday you are free, and you love concerts. Ola is your friend: to her you are ty.

turns.says: Cześć! Masz ochotę pójść na koncert?

meaning.en: Hi! Do you feel like going to a concert?

note.en: You love concerts and you are free at the weekend: say yes, *chętnie!*

turns.says: W piątek albo w sobotę. Kiedy masz czas?

meaning.en: On Friday or on Saturday. When are you free?

replies.text: W piątek nie mogę, ale w sobotę mam czas.

meaning.en: I can't on Friday, but on Saturday I'm free.

acceptedAnswers: W piątek nie mogę, ale w sobotę mam czas.

note.en: On Friday you have dinner at your grandma's: *w piątek nie mogę, ale w sobotę mam czas*.

turns.says: Dobrze, w sobotę. Zaczyna się o dwudziestej.

meaning.en: All right, on Saturday. It starts at 8 p.m.

replies.text: O dwudziestej? Przykro mi, nie dam rady.

meaning.en: At 8 p.m.? I'm sorry, I can't make it.

note.en: Eight in the evening suits you: say so and ask where to meet, *gdzie się spotkamy?*

turns.says: Może na rynku, pod pomnikiem? O wpół do ósmej.

meaning.en: Maybe in the square, by the monument? At half past seven.
Sure! Thank you for the invitation!

note.en: *Wpół do ósmej* is 7:30, half an hour before the concert, and it suits you: just agree and thank Ola.

meaning.en: Thank you for the invitation (to a woman, formal).

note.en: Ola is your friend: no *pani*, just *dziękuję za zaproszenie!*

turns.says: Nie ma za co! To w sobotę, pod pomnikiem!

meaning.en: You're welcome! See you on Saturday, by the monument!
